title: Prototype HVA on the service-backed sidecar boundary
decision: The HVA prototype should start by proving the service-backed workbook sidecar state boundary before investing in a more polished HVA UI surface.
context: The workbook family and sidecar JSON state decisions are accepted. The next implementation risk is whether workbook state can be discovered, read, and drafted through the local service in a reusable way.
rationale: Service-backed state proves the boundary future workbooks, audit history, import/export, and coworker local copies depend on. The UI can stay simple while this contract hardens.
alternatives_considered: Build a front-end-only HVA mock first
Hard-code Appendix A state directly into the React app
Wait for the full proposal/review workflow before adding any workbook state endpoint
consequences: SG-0010 should focus on discovery/read/draft-write service endpoints and path conventions
Approved workbook writes remain reserved for a future review/apply workflow
HVA UI work can consume a real local sidecar state shape instead of mock-only data
The sidecar skeleton should avoid Appendix A-only storage assumptions
